title: Chapter 197 Wei State'S Strategy
content:
Chapter 197 Wei State'S Strategy

Hearing Zhong Yu's words, King Wei was silent for a while, thinking in his heart whether this request was in line with Wei's interests

"That's right, what you said is common sense. If you have land but no people, then no matter how much land you have, it's useless! So what do you mean by Yuguo?" Wei Wang nodded, and Zhong Yu agreed. statement.

"The State of Wei captured the territory of the State of Qin, and I want half of the population!" Zhong Yu's request was expressed in a sonorous and forceful voice.

"What? Half of the population? You think too well!" King Wei exclaimed, unable to control his anger.

"So what? I have sent 300,000 troops from the Imperial Kingdom to lead the princes to attack the Qin army. If all of them are used to seize the territory, then I will definitely be able to win a large territory. How many people are in it? Presumably King Wei can also know it in his heart Go!" Zhong Yu also replied angrily.

"That's too much, half of the population, that's not hundreds of thousands, but two to three million people!" Wei Wang was also silent for a while, but still a little unwilling.

"Although I took away two or three million people, I also left half of them in the original place, and left a vast land. With these lands, with the abundance of the Central Plains, how many years will it take? Just It can reproduce the same population or even more!" Zhong Yu also shook his head, refusing to make any concessions.

"This, I have to think about it!" Wei Wang hesitated for a while, a little hard to make up his mind.

"King Wei, what is lacking in the countries of the world, especially the Three Jins, is not the population, but the sufficient strategic depth. Under Qin's successive attacks, your three countries have lost more than half of their territory. It is no longer worthy of being called a powerful country. In fact, now you can get not only half of the population, but also all the conquered territory, what is there to be dissatisfied with?" Zhong Yu directly urged Wei Wang's insatiable greed.

"However, with so many fewer people, the territory we conquered is also vast and sparsely populated. Moreover, relocating so many people rashly will make those who regained the lost land doubtful in their hearts!" Although he was a little shaken in his heart, Wei Wei Wang still hesitated, unable to make up his mind.

"If you can't agree to these conditions, then withdraw your troops immediately and see if you countries can win this Qin country! At that time, after being attacked by Qin soldiers, don't think about my country!" With a sneer, Zhong Yu said coldly.

Hearing this, King Wei was startled, and immediately regained consciousness.

Yes, among all the kingdoms in the world, the one that doesn’t have to worry about Qin’s pressure the most is the Yu Kingdom in front of them. They are located in the northern border and have the advantage of grasslands. It is far more difficult for Qin to attack them than to attack the Six Kingdoms. .

Now that they are willing to send troops to help the six countries attack Qin, besides them, they also have some ambitions for the world, probably more because of these populations!

It doesn't matter if they lost the Six Kingdoms, but if the Six Kingdoms lost the Yu Kingdom, that would be a great disaster!

Given the filth of the Six Kingdoms today, without a middleman standing in the way to ease, it is absolutely difficult to work together to fight against Qin again.

If they can't work together, they will definitely be defeated by Qin State. With this reminder, I am afraid that Qin State's pace of unifying the world will be accelerated quickly!

Wei Guo, I am afraid that it will not be far from being destroyed by then!

"Well, Prince Jing was just joking. The only condition that my country of Wei agreed to your country is, isn't it half of the population? In terms of the merits of the imperial country, it is completely worthy of it!" Wei Wang was full of flattery and embarrassment.

"It's good that the King of Wei understands the truth, and our Yuguo is not a greedy person. In this battle against Qin, we don't want any of the territory of the Qin State that was taken away. We only need half of the people on this territory! "Hearing Wei Wangfang's subdued words, he finally backed down, Zhong Yu nodded in satisfaction, but he didn't push too much.

"Where, these are what Yuguo deserves!" King Wei nodded quickly.

"Okay, now that we've finished talking, let's discuss the business! The defenders of Dongjun have been defeated by me. At this moment, everyone in Dongjun is in panic. It's time to take advantage of the opportunity." Since the division of interests After finishing talking, the next step is to deal with the Qin army, and it is also the most important thing now.

"What does King Jing mean?" King Wei was overjoyed when he heard this sentence, but he had just been beaten, so he didn't dare to be too obvious, so he could only test it out.

"It means to ask you Wei Guo to send troops to take down Dongjun!" Zhong Yu didn't care about Wei Wang's tricks, as long as Wei Guo still stood in the united front against Qin and sent troops to contribute, everything can be discussed .

"However, I won Dongjun for the sake of the past, and Russia can't go to the front to attack Qin, will it arouse the opinions of other countries?" Although he was very excited about this proposal, King Wei still had some hesitation.

"It's nothing to do with it. I will discuss it with other countries. They must understand for the sake of the overall situation!" His eyes turned to King Wei. Zhong Yu liked this greedy and timid person the most!

"What about after taking Dongjun? There is also Taojun next to Dongjun, and the defense is just as empty!" With the support of the person in front of him, King Wei's confidence was greatly increased, so he did not refuse, but became even more greedy!

"If the King of Wei has the ability, you can just go for it, and the King will not stop it!" Shaking his head in his heart, Zhong Yu actually had the idea of encouraging Wei Wang's careful thinking.

For the six eastern countries, the stronger they are, the more beneficial they will be to attack Qin.

And the stronger the state of Wei is, the greater his desire will be for King Wei, an insatiable person. And when the coalition forces defeated Qin State, forced Qin State into Hangu Pass again, and completely drove out of the Central Plains, it was almost time for the coalition forces to disband at that time.

After the disbandment, the six Kanto countries will have enough to eat, especially the three countries of Han, Zhao and Wei. The territories they lost will inevitably be recovered, and even slightly increased.

At that time, their strength will increase greatly, and they will definitely be dazzled by the victory and do some irrational things.

Among them, King Wei is a good target to use.

Now we can cultivate the power of Wei State, let him annex some counties and counties first, and become an early bird.

At that time, let him become the most profitable country among the six countries, and let his strength return to the early Warring States period, the kind of strength that surpassed all heroes.

At that time, what will King Wei, who thinks he has restored the glory of his ancestors, do?

I'm afraid he will attack other countries, right? Qi State, South Korea, or Zhao State and Chu State, there will always be one that he will pinch first as a soft persimmon.

And the Central Plains will be in turmoil again!
